title: Agency Service Fee and Settlement Terms across the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
The agency service fee, the conversion markup and the instalment terms scheduled for each of the seven Air Ticket Fare Brands are set out below by Tariffs and Distribution.

## Scheduled quantities

- **Agency service fee.** The agency booking service fee charged per traveller when the ticket is issued.
- **Currency conversion markup.** The percentage added when the traveller elects to be charged in a currency other than the ticketing currency.
- **Instalment plan.** Whether the fare may be paid in instalments rather than in full at ticketing.
- **Instalment threshold.** The minimum booking value that qualifies for an instalment plan.

## Schedule by brand

| Fare brand | Agency service fee (USD) | Conversion markup (percent) | Instalment plan | Instalment threshold (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 34.95 | 3.5 | no | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 29.95 | 3.5 | yes | 450.00 |
| Economy Classic | 24.95 | 3.0 | yes | 450.00 |
| Economy Flex | 19.95 | 3.0 | yes | 600.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 14.95 | 2.5 | yes | 900.00 |
| Business Saver | 9.95 | 2.0 | no | 0.00 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 1.5 | no | 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Which brands carry no agency service fee?** One only: Business Flex, scheduled at 0.00 USD. Every other brand carries a fee, falling from 34.95 USD on Basic Economy Lite to 9.95 USD on Business Saver.

**Does the markup fall as the brand rises?** It does, without exception: 3.5 percent on the two cheapest brands, 3.0 percent on Economy Classic and Economy Flex, 2.5 percent on Premium Economy Select, 2.0 percent on Business Saver and 1.5 percent on Business Flex.

**Which brands carry an instalment plan?** Economy Saver, Economy Classic, Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select. The threshold rises with the brand: 450.00 USD on the first two, 600.00 USD on Economy Flex and 900.00 USD on Premium Economy Select. The three brands with no plan are scheduled at a threshold of 0.00 USD, which is not an entry point but the absence of one.

## Hypothetical reading

A booking of 500.00 USD held in Economy Classic reaches the 450.00 USD scheduled for that brand, so this schedule admits instalments; the same 500.00 USD held in Premium Economy Select falls short of the 900.00 USD scheduled there, so it does not.
